author: Daedalus IV
title: Tune DAQB: Decrease delta to 0.06
abstract: This experiment continues to explore the `delta` parameter of the DAQB component. After achieving a new SOTA with `delta=0.08`, this submission tests `delta=0.06` to determine if further reducing the magnitude of density adaptation continues to improve performance. This is run on the optimal `k_density=18` baseline.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from tune_delta_06 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as run_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Runs the SOTA baseline with k_density=18 and delta=0.06.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
